definitions.explanation: converting or calculating one unit, currency, or measure into an equivalent in another system

examples.japanese: ドルを{円|えん}に{換算|かんさん}する。
{日本円|にほんえん}{換算|かんさん}で{約|やく}100{万円|まんえん}になる。
examples.english: It comes to approximately one million yen when converted to Japanese yen.

examples.japanese: カロリーを{運動量|うんどうりょう}に{換算|かんさん}すると、ウォーキング30{分|ぷん}に{相当|そうとう}する。
examples.english: Converted to exercise, it's equivalent to 30 minutes of walking.

examples.japanese: {為替|かわせ}レートで{換算|かんさん}した{金額|きんがく}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please confirm the amount converted at the exchange rate.

notes:
{換算|かんさん} means converting one unit or value into an equivalent in another system, commonly used for currencies, measurements, and comparisons.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {換|かん} (exchange, substitute)
- {算|さん} (calculate)

USAGE:
- {換算|かんさん}する (to convert - suru verb)
- 〜に{換算|かんさん}する (to convert to ~)
- 〜{換算|かんさん}で (in terms of ~, converted to ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {円|えん}{換算|かんさん} (converted to yen)
- {年間|ねんかん}{換算|かんさん} (annualized, on a yearly basis)
- {換算|かんさん}レート (conversion rate)
- {換算|かんさん}{係数|けいすう} (conversion factor)

CONTEXTS:
- Finance: currency conversion
- Science: unit conversion
- Business: comparing values across different metrics
- Daily life: comparing prices, distances, calories, etc.

RELATED TERMS:
- {変換|へんかん} (conversion, transformation)
- {両替|りょうがえ} (currency exchange - actual exchange)
- {計算|けいさん} (calculation)
- {算出|さんしゅつ} (calculation, computation)
